Name: High Res Portraits for Adarin's girl mod
Author: moirgane
Description:
This is a High Res version I made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2165]Adarin's Girl Mod[/url]﻿ that I use alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888]DCBurger's Portraits[/url]﻿. I decided to upload them for more marriage options for multiplayer. 

:Disclaimer: 
I used some aspects from DCBurger's Portrait mod like props and for Elena, the hair. I recolored Adarin's sprites for Alex, Harriet and Elena.

YOU NEED [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999/?]Platonymous's Portraiture[/url] FOR THIS MOD.

Head on over to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888]DCBurger's page[/url] (for the Portraits) and to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2165]Adarin's Girl Mod[/url]﻿ (for the sprites) for install instructions! :)
